name: bench-rosetta
title: Rosetta Code solutions, up to 2 per language, 848 languages
labels: the contributor (the solution's language heading on rosettacode.org)
sampling: random per language (seed 20261003): up to 2 solutions of 2 tasks, among files of 3+ non-blank lines and at most 100 KB
strengths: the widest coverage: 848 Rosetta Code languages, the tail included (the median language has 18 solutions in the dump)
labels declared by the authors, produced by no identifier
the same tasks across languages: the language differs, not the topic
two thirds of the cases in languages Linguist does not know: an honest measure of coverage
weaknesses: file names derived from the label through acmeism's extension table (often invented): with names, a tool reads the label back; the content-only runs are the fair reading
wiki code blocks, often short (202 cases of 3-4 non-blank lines), not files of projects
fine-grained categories: dialects and implementations (BBC BASIC, Free Pascal) are languages of their own, not mapped to Linguist's broader names
Rosetta Code is training data of some classifiers and, most likely, of every large language model
